eidolons.name: Stray Bird of Summer
eidolons.desc: "Summer Songbirds" will keep a tally of 100% of the non-True DMG dealt by ally targets. When using the Memosprite Skill, additionally deals True DMG to the enemy target with the highest HP, equal to (11% + current Vibes × 0.1%) of the total tally. Then, clears 50% of the tally.

eidolons.name: A Heart of Still Water
eidolons.desc: Ally targets' All-Type RES PEN increases by 18%. The upper limit of Robin • Summeretto's Vibes increases by 20. The first time an ally target uses an ability during any target's turn to cause Robin • Summeretto to gain Vibes, she gains an additional 2 points.

eidolons.name: Echoes Left Along the Way
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Her Variation on the Theme
eidolons.desc: Upon entering the "Fever" state, immediately gains 12 Vibes, and increases the SPD of "Summer Songbirds" by an amount equal to (20% + current Vibes × 0.5%).

eidolons.name: To Chase the Dawn Anew
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: A Song Yet Unnamed
eidolons.desc: Increases the Memosprite Skill's DMG multiplier by 100% of its original value. While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto can store her Ultimate up to 2 times. After entering the "Fever" state for the first time in this battle or when the "Fever" countdown's turn starts, regenerates a fixed 140 Energy.

basic.name: The Sea Sings in My Key
basic.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to {0}% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP to one enemy.

skill.name: Summer Strums the Soul
skill.desc: Summons the memosprite "Summer Songbirds" Bessie. If any member of the "Summer Songbirds" is already on the field, restores their HP by an amount equal to {0}% of "Summer Songbirds'" Max HP, and gains 6 Vibes.

ult.name: Ascend That Rhapsody in Blue
ult.desc: Advances the action of one designated ally character (excluding Robin • Summeretto) by 100% and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to {0}% of their Max Energy. Then, grants them the "Special Guest" effect. When the "Special Guest" character or their summon attacks, they additionally grant Robin • Summeretto 2 Vibes but cannot make other friendly targets gain the action advance effect. This lasts for 2 turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this character's turn.

talent.name: Wings Heed No Borders
talent.desc:
Memosprite "Summer Songbirds" has an initial Max HP equal to 70% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP and an initial SPD equal to 180% of Robin • Summeretto's SPD. When an ally target uses an attack, or when they provide healing or Shield for the first time in any target's turn, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes by 1 point, capped at 50. While "Summer Songbirds" Bessie is on the field, if Robin • Summeretto's Vibes is 6 or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie, and if Vibes is 12 or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Paddie. When all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted upon Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds", starts the "Fever" state, and deploys a Zone. When ally targets deal DMG within the Zone, they ignore a percentage of enemy targets' DEF equal to ({0}% + Vibes × 0.5%).
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.

extra.name: Chirrup Quartet
extra.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to {0}% of "Summer Songbirds'" Max HP to all enemies.

extra.name: A Warble of Wings
extra.desc: While in the "Fever" state, the "Summer Songbirds" and a countdown will appear on the Action Order. And the DMG dealt by Robin • Summeretto and "Summer Songbirds" increases by an amount equal to ({0}% + Vibes × {1}%). When "Summer Songbirds'" turn starts, uses the Memosprite Skill. The countdown has an initial SPD of 140. And when its turn starts, deducts 50% of the current Vibes (minimum 12 points). When the Vibes reaches 0, the "Summer Songbirds" disappears and Robin • Summeretto exits the "Fever" state. While the "Summer Songbirds" is on the field, based on the number of its members present, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by {2}%/{3}%/{4}% respectively.

extra.name: Near the Sea's Heartbeat
extra.desc: When the "Summer Songbirds" gets summoned, regenerates 20 Energy for Robin • Summeretto.

extra.name: Astride Summer's Nightwind
extra.desc: When the "Summer Songbirds" disappears, Robin • Summeretto's action advances by 50%.

technique.name: We Are the Melody
technique.desc: After using Technique, advances action by 20% at the start of the next battle, immediately gains 6 Vibes, and increases all allies' DMG dealt by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

ability_1.name: Deviated Chords
ability_1.desc: When an ally target causes Robin • Summeretto to gain Vibes, if their ATK is higher than Robin • Summeretto's, increases that target's ATK by an amount equal to (16% + Vibes × 0.4%) of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP. Otherwise, increases that target's CRIT DMG by an amount equal to (40% + Vibes × 1.5%). Lasts for 2 turn(s).

ability_2.name: Improvised Blues
ability_2.desc: When Robin • Summeretto or the "Summer Songbirds" receive healing or Shield provided by teammates, causes Robin • Summeretto to gain 12 stack(s) of "Groove," capped at 12. The first time Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes during any target's turn, if she has "Groove," consumes 1 stack of "Groove" and regenerates a fixed 3 Energy.

ability_3.name: Rebuilt Harmony
ability_3.desc: Increases the CRIT Rate of Robin • Summeretto and "Summer Songbirds" by 50%.

lightCones.name: Rise and Sing
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 30%/37%/45%/52%/60%. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point for allies. When entering combat, advances the wearer's action by 30%/32%/35%/37%/40% and grants the wearer "New Melody" for 2 turn(s). While the wearer has "New Melody," all allies' SPD increases by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%.

lightCones.name: Memory's Curtain Never Falls
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by 6%/7.5%/9%/10.5%/12%. After the wearer uses Skill, increases the DMG dealt by all allies by 8%/10%/12%/14%/16%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

lightCones.name: The Story's Next Page
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 16%/20%/24%/28%/32%. After the wearer's memosprite attacks, the Outgoing Healing of the wearer and their memosprite increases by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

lightCones.name: Time Waits for No One
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 18%/21%/24%/27%/30% and Outgoing Healing by 12%/14%/16%/18%/20%. When the wearer heals allies, record the amount of Outgoing Healing. When any ally launches an attack, a random attacked enemy takes Additional DMG equal to 36%/42%/48%/54%/60% of the recorded Outgoing Healing value. The type of this Additional DMG is of the same Type as the wearer's. This Additional DMG is not affected by other buffs, and can only occur 1 time per turn.

lightCones.name: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's SPD by 18%/21%/24%/27%/30%. When the wearer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, consumes all allies' HP equal to 1%/1.2%/1.5%/1.8%/2% of their current HP, and after the next attack of the wearer's memosprite, enables it to additionally deal 1 instance of Additional DMG equal to 250%/312.5%/375%/437.5%/500% of the total consumed HP to the attacked target, with the damage type based on the memosprite's type. Then, the total consumed HP is reset. When the wearer's memosprite uses Memosprite Skill, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by 18%/22.5%/27%/31.5%/36%, lasting for 2 turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.

lightCones.name: To Evernight's Stars
lightCones.description: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 30%/37%/45%/52%/60%. When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability, the wearer gains "Noctis." While the wearer has "Noctis," the DMG dealt by all ally memosprites ignores 20%/22%/25%/27%/30% of the targets' DEF. Increases the DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprite by 30%/37%/45%/52%/60%. When the wearer's memosprite disappears, the wearer recovers 8/10/12/14/16 Energy. Effects of the same type cannot stack.

relicSets.name: World-Remaking Deliverer
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases CRIT Rate by 8%. 4-pc: After the wearer uses Basic ATK or Skill, if the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases Max HP of the wearer and their memosprite by 24%, and increases all allies' DMG dealt by 15%, lasting until after the wearer's next use of Basic ATK or Skill.

relicSets.name: Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases SPD by 6%. 4-pc: When using Skill or Ultimate on one ally target, increases the ability target's CRIT DMG by 18%, lasting for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).

relicSets.name: Diviner of Distant Reach
relicSets.description: 2-pc: Increases SPD by 6%. 4-pc: Before entering combat, if the wearer's SPD is greater than or equal to 120/160, increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 10%/18%. When the wearer uses Elation Skill for the first time in each battle, increases all allies' Elation by 10%. This effect cannot stack.

planarSets.name: Amphoreus, The Eternal Land
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. While the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases all allies' SPD by 8%. This effect cannot be stacked.

planarSets.name: Sprightly Vonwacq
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 120 or higher, the wearer's action is Advanced Forward by 40% immediately upon entering battle.

planarSets.name: Lushaka, the Sunken Seas
planarSets.description: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. If the wearer is not the first character in the team lineup, then increases the ATK of the first character in the team lineup by 12%.

teams.name: Summeretto ATK Team
teams.description: Robin • Summeretto supports ATK-based damage dealers. The same core works with Saber and Gilgamesh, Archer and Rin Tohsaka, or Himeko • Nova and Welt. Sparkle, Sunday or the Remembrance Trailblazer can take a flex slot.

teams.name: Summeretto with Saber
teams.description: Saber as the main damage dealer with Gilgamesh as a second one.

teams.name: Summeretto HP Team
teams.description: She also supports HP-based teams. Mydei can replace Castorice, and Cerydra or Mortenax Blade can replace Hyacine.

teams.name: Summeretto Beginner Team
teams.description: Easy-to-get characters only, with Serval as the damage dealer.

lore.description:
Soaring clearest skies and bluest oceans, wings sweep up the sea spray, transforming it into a new melody.
Following the lingering echoes of memory, she embraces the unexpected along the way, seeking inspiration for a melodic variation—
Beyond the melody, how else can the Harmony sing?
stories: She hears the sound of a beautiful dream shattering. Ten system hours ago, the Charmony Festival was forced to be canceled. Three system hours ago, the confessional of Bronze Melodia was swamped by lost and confused masses. One system hour ago, The Family issued a severe condemnation against the Oak Family, with an inquiry and manhunt for the fugitives expected in the coming days. "Praise be to the Great One, everlasting be the harmony..." The majestic Charmony resonates within the parliament hall. However, she can clearly see that the Five Lineages were chanting slogans of solidarity just seconds ago, only to immediately turn around and scheme to partition power and seize benefits. "Miss Robin, thank you for your singing, but did Bronze Melodia truly... abandon the Path of Harmony..." A Dreamchaser who once prayed to Sunday finds her, her face twisted in agony. She wants so desperately to comfort the helpless, lost soul just as her brother used to do, but even the most beautiful song feels hollow and powerless right now. "Miss Robin, did the Harmony make Dreamflux Reef turn out like this?" "Miss Robin, don't they always treat everyone as family?" The children from the choir crowd around her, laughing and playing, but their innocent questions leave her completely at a loss. Looking into those bright, shining eyes, she can only pull them into her arms in silence. "Never seen you in this state before..." At the Dreamjolt Hostelry, she accepts a soothing blend from Siobhan, allowing the bitter, slightly tart flavor overtake across her palate. "Once, I understood that I sang for Harmony, but now, I cannot even discern how much further I can walk..." Siobhan gave her shoulder a gentle pat. "This isn't your burden to carry." She shakes her head, "But when I cannot even bring myself to believe, how can I sway anyone else?" "You know, your brother used to come here for a drink from time to time, too." "My brother?" "He always sat in the shadows, looking just as troubled as you do now. Then one day, he penned a line in the lounge guestbook and never came back..." She gazes at the familiar handwriting, feeling as though she has arrived at a similar crossroad. "It is the people who forge the path, not the path that waits for people."

She heard the gasping breath of ideals buckling under their own weight. Only when she truly stepped into the spotlight did she realize that being swept along by forces beyond her control was simply the norm. "Go, child. Take the stage. For the Triple-Faced Soul, for The Family, and for everyone." The thunderous voice left no room for refusal. Rally after rally, she wove sweet dreams of Harmony for her audiences with a voice growing ever more weary. But looking upon the same zeal burning in the eyes of the crowd, she felt a sudden shiver run down her spine. "Robin, do you still hold true to the Family's Path of Harmony?" She had lost count of how many times an envoy of the main Family had come to interrogate members of the Oak Family like this. "I have always been faithful to the Path of Harmony." "Then answer this: Will you uphold the Family's philosophy, uniting all through song, that they may be united as one?" "I..." Her throat ran dry, and she found herself speechless. She often dreamed of being thrust onto a grand, exalted stage. Countless cold and indifferent messengers pulled at her limbs. She opened her mouth, yet a voice that was not her own came out; she raised her arm, yet it moved against her will. In her hands were endless stringed puppets beneath the stage. They followed her every step, spinning and leaping in kind. She wanted to struggle. She wanted to run. But when she jolted awake, she found herself exactly where she started. On those sleepless nights, she chose to stop tossing and turning. Instead, she stepped out into the deep Penaconian night. Wandering through the darkness, she sought to leave it all behind, pouring herself into the things she still had power to change. She returned to Dreamflux Reef, raising funds through charity performances to support struggling residents, and continued sponsoring the growth and education of the children there. She visited every part of the dreamscape. Her songs consoled the weary workers tucked away in its forgotten corners, as she offered them free music lessons. She listened to the prayers and wishes of every soul who came to confess, never making assertions, only sharing her own inspiration... "Whether it's the strong defending the weak or the strong exploiting the weak... what I've always cared about is each of those vulnerable individuals and their dignity..."

She heard new voices growing vibrantly. At Dreamflux Reef, the children had formed a new band. With her continued support, even more orphans were arriving here through dream devices and learning to sing. "Miss Robin, let us sing for you!" A cool electric guitar rang out, the bassist bounced along, and a girl sang at the top of her lungs: "Dance beneath a diamond-studded starry sky, and let's forget today until tomorrow comes..." She couldn't help but dance along with them, lost in a momentary daze... "Once upon a time, I had a dream of becoming a rock 'n' roll singer too..." At the Golden Hour, her album centered on the theme of chasing dreams once again drew countless adventurers here to make their mark. "Wait, isn't that Robin, Penacony's very own ambassador and superstar?" Someone had recognized her, and she slipped off her sunglasses with a bashful smile. Within seconds, a crowd had gathered around her. "Your music motivated me, and I made my very first fortune right here in Penacony! Drinks on me, everyone! And that includes you, Miss Robin!" As an improvisational jazz tune drifted out of the Dreamjolt Hostelry, joy leapt and danced in the glow of the lights, painting every face with a golden smile. Stepping into the "Moment of Daybreak," a group of young people from the Dawn Factory waved to her. Ever since she had called for reform of the unreasonable working hours, the staff finally had some breathing room for their mental health. At the concerts she held regularly, she came to know a group of people who shared the dream of chasing their passions. "Miss Robin, check out what we've been tinkering with lately: new wave music for the electronic age!" Nimble fingers danced across the keys as the rippling waves of the theremin wove into a soaring melody. "This is the Land of the Dreams, the Land of the Dreams that belongs to everyone..." ... Countless voices wove together — some rough and raspy, others soft and young — forming a symphony of sweet dreams. No need for a conductor or rigid uniformity. She realized, almost in a daze, that a single trace of freedom's song was all it took for people to pour out their inspiration. "Then... what would my own music notes sound like?"

The sky over Astropolis stretched far wider than she had ever imagined. Strolling through the coastal palm groves, she watched gulls skim the cresting waves with pure delight, following their flight until they shrank to distant specks on the horizon. Only then did she remember she was still tethered to her small corner of reality. Yet that chance reunion with the Trailblaze had flung open a chest of long-bottled inspiration. She had come searching for the Lost Echo of Gopher Wood, and ended up tangled in a mysterious money challenge instead. Watching Trailblazer plummet from the top of a wave straight into the depths of crushing debt, it seemed like she had lived an entire lifetime of surprises in just a few short days. When her companion fell into a trap, she made a decision that caught everyone off guard: placing herself right in the eye of the storm. Was it a motivation from the Trailblaze? Was it the thrill of a gambler riding the waves? She didn't know why. But then, inspiration never asks for permission, the moment it arrives, there's no need to think. The melody simply flows from the heart. "All I need is just a little courage to improvise. And from there, the music notes find their way to each other..." Beneath the clear sky of a foreign land, every long-suppressed feeling seemed to finally find its outlet. She remembered the sound of sweet dreams shattering: sorrow and parting like blue foam, a single sip enough to break the heart. She remembered the gasping breath of ideals buckling under their own weight, the heavy drumbeat pounding in time with her heart, a weary soul dragging herself forward, searching. Her eyes looked up to the sky, yet remained bound to earth. She remembered the vibrant surge of new sounds: myriad different voices, raw and unpolished, yet capable of moving the world and rallying countless to stand as one. "People forge their own paths, but every step we take also shapes who we are." When the applause thundered, she was no longer terrified, no longer seeking answers. Whether it was the Family's harmony or freedom's blues, each was a landscape of her life. No need to rush, no need to linger. She already had her answer. To simply chase after the wind. And then, continue to soar.
